verified_behavior: Server alone creates transition marker from actual new selected source/game/canonical association/lease reincarnation; strict client payload cannot inject it.
Initial viewer snapshots, policy/permission reconciliation, heartbeats, name-only edits, source fallback, server-scoped and owner deliveries never trigger notice provenance.
Selected physical source incarnation and lease are rechecked after fresh policy work, with no map mutex held across repository calls.
Hook hydration/remount seeds baseline; only live higher-revision store updates can cause notices. No persisted AppNotification or history rows are manufactured.
Accepted globally authorized friends only, with current auth/epoch/relationship/loaded preference/block provenance; ignored, blocked, offline, DND, disconnected and source-revoked rows fail closed.
Own comparison uses local cached consent-filtered registered-game getter without requiring account game-sharing opt-in or sending local source IDs to the server.

Same-game comparison only accepts both explicit steam:730 canonical associations, never matching raw titles or per-device registration UUIDs. Unknown titles still receive truthful shared-activity notices.
Two independent device-local preferences default false, persist locally, reject invalid cached shapes and cannot be enabled by cloud hydration.
At most three metadata-only notices, 80-character labels/titles and existing 3-20 second accessibility duration. No user/source/Steam/ticket identifiers enter HUD DTO.

Appending notices preserves existing transport IDs. Privacy revocation clears native rows immediately before React, then remints surviving transport IDs without extending original expiry or creating another logical transition. Natural expiry does not clear unrelated native notices.
Existing persistent friend activity widget also applies ignored-user and current loaded preference/block ownership fences.
